blocks.text: The module documentation defines node identity, workspace scoping, embedding failure posture, and the domain-agnostic role of this vector-backed store.
blocks.title: Node-store boundary

blocks.text: write_node validates node types, creates an id, embeds content, records usage, builds metadata, and upserts the vector with optional session linkage.
blocks.title: Embedding and upsert

blocks.text: get_node fetches metadata by exact vector id. delete_node removes a node, while rename_node applies a metadata PATCH so content and tags remain intact.
blocks.title: Direct node mutations

blocks.text: search_nodes embeds the query, applies workspace and optional section/type filters at the vector service, then performs client-side tag filtering and returns scored metadata.
blocks.title: Similarity search

blocks.text: list_nodes scans vector pages without a query vector, keeps only the requested workspace and type, optionally includes embeddings, and returns partial results after a scan failure.
blocks.title: Workspace listing

gotchas: Embedding and vector failures return None or empty/partial results.
The module logs the configured provider key name, not a secret value.
purpose: This module gives notes and other artifacts one domain-agnostic vector-backed node store. It embeds content, persists searchable metadata, scopes reads to a workspace, supports tag and type filters, and degrades vector failures without taking down the caller.
summary: Stores, retrieves, searches, renames, deletes, and lists workspace-scoped knowledge graph nodes in a vector index.

symbols.returns: node id or None on embedding/upsert failure
symbols.summary: Embeds content and upserts a workspace-scoped node with searchable metadata.
Fetches one node's metadata by workspace-scoped vector id.
Deletes one workspace-scoped node from the vector index.
Patches a node title without replacing its stored content or tags.
Embeds a query and returns workspace-scoped similar nodes with optional metadata filters.

symbols.returns: node list, possibly partial on failure
symbols.summary: Paginates all vector records and returns nodes belonging to a workspace.
